_note: Editable planning defaults used by lib/sb4.ts. Every number here is a planning assumption, not a legal requirement, unless the note says it comes from SB 4.

sqftPerParkingSpace.note: Per kept parking space including aisles and drive lanes.

setbackPct.note: Share of gross buildable area lost to setbacks and site circulation.

townhome.note: Habitat townhome: 900 sq ft footprint over two stories plus a small yard; ~1,850 sq ft of land per unit once shared drive aisles are counted (about 23 homes per acre).

flats.note: Stacked flats: three stories of 850 sq ft units; ~750 sq ft of land per unit (about 58 homes per acre). Practical count is capped at 1.1× the SB 4 minimum to keep projects at Habitat scale.

peoplePerHousehold.note: Average Habitat OC partner-family size used for people-housed estimates.

affordabilityYears.note: From SB 4: ownership units carry a 45-year affordability deed restriction (55 years for rental).

defaultKeepParkingShare.note: Default scenario keeps half of today's parking spaces for the congregation.

landValuePerAcre.note: Illustrative assumption only: approximate Orange County land value per acre used to describe what a land partnership is worth. Not an appraisal.

density.note: From SB 4: minimum density in a metropolitan jurisdiction like Orange County is 30 units per acre, or 40 where the zone does not allow residential use.

sb4.note: Objective standards from Gov. Code § 65913.16 as summarized in the HCD SB 4 fact sheet.
